attr.title: Impostor Factory
attr.desc: A narrative-driven RPG Maker game from Freebird Games, continuing the story told in To the Moon and Finding Paradise.
attr.inst: Buy the game from your favorite store Steam / GOG and copy the gamedata of your game to impostorfactory/gamedata/. If using the GOG linux version, place the impostor_factory_*.sh installer at the root of the impostorfactory folder, or extract the contents of data/noarch/game/ into impostorfactory/gamedata/.
